import ast,base64,hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1])
control=base64.b64decode('')
expected='fd25b6732986acd99ecfe8cb3d0d5f192a994362d8e8739297e258eb8c9412d4'
if hashlib.sha256(control).hexdigest()!=expected:raise RuntimeError('Approved budget runtime source changed')
tree=ast.parse(control.decode())
nodes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.Assign,ast.FunctionDef,ast.ClassDef)) and not (isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='main')]
namespace={'__name__':'vfarl_owned_process_runtime_observation'}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),'approved-budget-wrapper-source','exec'),namespace)
started=time.monotonic()
code=namespace['run_bounded_command']([sys.executable,'-I','-S','-c','import subprocess,sys,time,os,json\ngrand=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,\'-I\',\'-S\',\'-c\',"import os,time,signal,json; os.setsid(); signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN); print(json.dumps(dict(event=\'budget_probe_grandchild\',pid=os.getpid(),ppid=os.getppid(),sid=os.getsid(0))),flush=True); time.sleep(2)"])\nprint(json.dumps(dict(event=\'budget_probe_child\',pid=os.getpid(),ppid=os.getppid(),sid=os.getsid(0),grandchild_pid=grand.pid)),flush=True)\ntime.sleep(2)\n'],out/'owned-process-budget-receipt.json',execution_seconds=.75,cleanup_seconds=1.5,provenance=dict(control_source_sha256=expected,mechanism_only=True,model_payload_present=False))
result=dict(control_source_sha256=expected,actual_guard_returncode=code,actual_guard_wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,execution_seconds=.75,cleanup_seconds=1.5,child_and_grandchild_sleep_seconds=2,model_or_oracle_executed=False)
(out/'primitive-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+chr(10))
print(json.dumps(dict(event='budget_probe_supervisor_result',**result)),flush=True)
sys.exit(code)
